ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on distal lobes versus 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle junction and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones on distal lobes. Left lobe exhibits multiple dark linear streaks. Right lobe contains a single, high-contrast dark circular spot within the white field. Black pigmentation radiates outward from the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees and a depth of approximately 15% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. Distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature along the trailing edge from notch to distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, irregular yellowish-white and dark pixel clumps at both distal tips. Multiple small, dark circular spots distributed across the white ventral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned dark linear streaks observed on the left lobe, primarily horizontal in orientation. Sparse, shorter linear disruptions visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced surface irregularity and heavy encrustation at both distal tips; no visible amputations or large-scale trauma marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique isolated dark focal spot in the middle of the right lobe's white pigmentation field.
